note: Account value each minute of the regular session, ET. Stocks = quantity held at the time of the run x 1-minute close; total = stocks + cash + option value (a short option is negative). Rolling 7 trading days; filled in each time the update workflow runs (~every 15 min).
option_mark_method: UPRO Oct 16 2026 $154 call: each minute uses the latest known option price at or before that minute - a bid/ask mark recorded by this tracker (held constant between runs, ~15 min apart), or a Yahoo 1-minute trade print (28 in the last 7 days; the contract trades thinly), or the previous day's mark
